case_plans.title: McDonald’s — McHappy Day & Campaign Creative
case_plans.card_summary: Campaign concepts, scripts and channel creative that connected awareness with participation.
case_plans.task: Give a seasonal fundraising campaign a clear path from attention to registration and giving, alongside ongoing product launches.
case_plans.role: Digital strategy, concept and messaging; scripts, banners, social copy, voiceovers and campaign coordination through the agency context.

stages.title: Map the action
stages.text: Connected paid social, website and CRM around one participation journey.

stages.title: Build the message
stages.text: Developed the campaign concept and copy, with channel-specific creative and production direction.

stages.title: Carry it through delivery
stages.text: Coordinated partners and campaign operations; across product launches, managed up to three concurrent campaigns in peak weeks.

case_plans.result: McHappy Day recorded 200K registrations, $230K+ in donations and +20% year-on-year social-audience growth.
case_plans.scope_note: Campaign-wide reported outcomes across the fundraising journey.

case_plans.title: Volkswagen — Wow! Tiguan
case_plans.card_summary: One campaign idea carried through TV, digital, outdoor and social with three production houses.
case_plans.task: Make global campaign standards locally relevant without losing a recognizable central idea.
case_plans.role: Agency creative-pod lead and production coordinator; copy, key visuals, banners, radio scripts and localized toolkits.

stages.title: Adapt the idea
stages.text: Translated global toolkits into useful market concepts, including “Wow! Tiguan.”

stages.title: Plan the system
stages.text: Developed copy, key visuals and production guidance across formats.

stages.title: Coordinate the delivery
stages.text: Led the creative pod and coordinated three external production houses across TV, digital, outdoor and social.

case_plans.result: A coordinated multi-channel campaign toolkit and production workflow.
case_plans.scope_note: Agency campaign work, shown alongside labeled portfolio adaptations and format studies.

case_plans.title: Coca-Cola / Fanta — Taste This Winter
case_plans.card_summary: A multi-video animated campaign built from concepts, scripts, storyboards and a repeatable visual world.
case_plans.task: Expand one seasonal idea into distinct short stories with clear product moments.
case_plans.role: Concepts, scripts, key visuals, storyboards and creative direction for animated storytelling.

stages.title: Find the story engine
stages.text: Developed campaign concepts and scripts for the multi-video “Taste This Winter” series.

stages.title: Make the world
stages.text: Shaped key visuals and storyboards so each episode shared a recognizable visual language.

stages.title: Shape the cut
stages.text: Directed pacing, product reveal and brand hold; explored a tighter proposed 15-second CTV presentation study.

case_plans.result: A multi-video creative system with material adapted for television, digital and outdoor contexts.
case_plans.scope_note: Original film frames and campaign creative; the 15-second CTV edit is a proposed portfolio study.

case_plans.title: SCREAM 7 — Paramount Pictures × Complex Art Competition
case_plans.card_summary: A five-work poster series; “IN PROGRESS” selected for the official Complex Los Angeles exhibition.
case_plans.task: Create fresh tension inside a familiar film franchise without relying on the same mask image every time.
case_plans.role: Concept development, visual storytelling, art direction and design for an independent competition entry.

stages.title: Explore the tension
stages.text: Developed visual metaphors around the phone, surveillance, identity and the audience’s role in watching.

stages.title: Build the series
stages.text: Created a five-work competition series with reusable image and type elements.

stages.title: Refine for impact
stages.text: Reviewed legibility, franchise recognition and the strength of each idea in a gallery setting.

case_plans.result: Official competition winner; “IN PROGRESS” was selected for the Complex Los Angeles exhibition in February 2026.
case_plans.scope_note: Competition entry: one selected work from the original five-work series. Paramount and Complex identify the competition context.
case_plans.hero_caption: Cloud Ghostface / landscape adaptation of original poster

case_plans.title: NostalgAI Recordz — Releases, Artwork & Commerce
case_plans.card_summary: An independent release workflow linking artwork and launch content with physical products and Shopify commerce.
case_plans.task: Make the release journey coherent from creative development and production files to a product an audience can discover and buy.
case_plans.role: Founder, creative direction, artwork and prepress, release planning, Shopify workflows and production coordination.

stages.title: Prepare the release
stages.text: Connected source material, production coordination, metadata and partner communication.

stages.title: Develop the visual identity
stages.text: Directed artwork, prepress and launch content. An independent t.A.T.u. anniversary study compared 20 cover alternatives before developing selected vinyl packaging.

stages.title: Connect the store
stages.text: Built repeatable processes for product data, Shopify, launch assets and fulfillment coordination.

case_plans.result: A repeatable release-to-commerce workflow; 500+ release and content assets coordinated across music projects.
case_plans.scope_note: 500+ is an aggregate across music projects. The t.A.T.u. anniversary packaging is an independent visual-development concept.
case_plans.hero_caption: Selected anniversary cover / vinyl packaging concept

case_plans.title: Artist Releases — Sony Music-Related Projects
case_plans.card_summary: Release concepts, artwork and PR across music, television and live entertainment.
case_plans.task: Carry an artist’s identity and story consistently across release artwork, promotion and entertainment formats.
case_plans.role: Creative preparation, release concepts, cover art and PR through EK Publishing & Production, a Sony Music partner.

stages.title: Shape the release story
stages.text: Connected the artist’s identity with a creative direction and audience-facing messages.

stages.title: Create the material
stages.text: Developed release concepts, cover artwork and PR across artist releases, television and live entertainment.

stages.title: Coordinate across formats
stages.text: Worked with creative teams and external production partners, including creative preparation with 2× GRAMMY-winning producer Walter Afanasieff.

case_plans.result: Related releases reached 100M+ streams; original release artwork and entertainment work form the project record.
case_plans.scope_note: Sony Music-related partner projects. Streams refer to the related releases. Email, streaming and merchandise extensions are portfolio concepts.

case_plans.title: Unilever — Together Apart
case_plans.card_summary: A brand story carried from digital campaign to short film presented in Cannes and a later series format.
case_plans.task: Build an entertainment story that could keep reaching an audience beyond its first brand-campaign format.
case_plans.role: Promotional concepts, trailers, key art and PR across the project’s changing formats.

stages.title: Frame the brand story
stages.text: Developed promotional concepts and creative around the Unilever digital campaign.

stages.title: Present it as film
stages.text: Adapted key art, trailers and PR for “Together Apart,” a short film presented in Cannes.

stages.title: Extend the audience
stages.text: Carried the story into a later “Music Without Make-Up” episode and related promotional material.

case_plans.result: One story moved through a digital brand campaign, a Cannes presentation and a later series format.
case_plans.scope_note: Presented in Cannes. The cinema audience image is a screening visualization; the poster is an English portfolio adaptation.
case_plans.hero_caption: Together Apart / English Unilever film-poster adaptation

case_plans.title: MageWorx — E-Commerce Product & Campaign Creative
case_plans.card_summary: Feature-led product stories, social ads and reusable layouts for an e-commerce extension portfolio.
case_plans.task: Make a portfolio of commerce extensions easy to understand without reducing every product to a dense feature list.
case_plans.role: Product-benefit copy, social concepts, ad variations, reusable Figma layouts and creative direction.

stages.title: Clarify the benefit
stages.text: Translated extension features into clear product messages and offers.

stages.title: Build the campaign language
stages.text: Created feature-led social advertising with a consistent background palette, visual hierarchy and product emphasis.

stages.title: Make it repeatable
stages.text: Developed reusable layouts and presentation studies for components, landing pages and additional ad formats.

case_plans.result: A connected creative system for web and social, with distinct product messages and repeatable production assets.
case_plans.scope_note: Original social advertisements, extended through component, campaign-format and landing-page portfolio studies.
case_plans.hero_caption: MageWorx / campaign-wall visualization in lilac brand palette

case_plans.title: Cal Poly DxHub × AWS — EHS Mentor
case_plans.card_summary: A working training and compliance workflow prototype, from problem framing to a presented system.
case_plans.task: Turn disconnected safety documents and training records into clearer assignments, reporting states and human-review workflows.
case_plans.role: Problem framing, workflow mapping, prototype design, AI-assisted implementation, testing and presentation during the AI Summer Camp.

stages.title: Map the work
stages.text: Defined users, training requirements, assignments, administrative views and reporting states.

stages.title: Build and revise
stages.text: Developed the prototype with Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker and Render, using AI-assisted implementation and iterative testing.

stages.title: Present the operating model
stages.text: Demonstrated the system, reviewed the workflow and explored Amazon Bedrock at concept/prototype level.

case_plans.result: Developed and presented a working prototype. Selected for a cohort of 100 from nearly 1,300 applicants.
case_plans.scope_note: Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker and Render prototype. Amazon Bedrock explored at concept/prototype level during the program.
case_plans.hero_caption: EHS Mentor / interface and device visualization

case_plans.title: Société Générale / BelRosBank — Campaigns & Website Delivery
case_plans.card_summary: Bank-side research, creative and website delivery across a changing brand.
case_plans.task: Keep products, campaigns and digital touchpoints coherent through the BelRosBank to Alfa-Bank transition.
case_plans.role: Bank-side competitor and feature research, developer evaluation and selection, delivery oversight, campaign concepts and photography art direction.

stages.title: Research the options
stages.text: Compared competitors and website features, evaluated developers and helped shape the solution.

stages.title: Direct the experience
stages.text: Oversaw implementation with external developer Novy Site and worked through feedback.

stages.title: Carry the brand into campaigns
stages.text: Developed product messaging and art-directed photography, brochures, editorial advertising and retail communications.

case_plans.result: The broader digital work recorded 4× year-on-year conversions. Website team recognition: BelRosBank — third place, TIBO 2012; successor Alfa-Bank — first place, Best Bank Website 2013, and second place, TIBO 2014.
case_plans.scope_note: Conversions refer to the broader digital work. Website awards are team recognition for the named bank projects.

case_plans.title: BASF / Frandesa — The Battle for the Harvest
case_plans.card_summary: A technical crop-protection story developed into a 14-minute corporate spy film.
case_plans.task: Make a specialist agricultural subject engaging enough to work as a narrative film.
case_plans.role: Script development, shot planning, actor selection and production-partner selection in the Frandesa employment context.

stages.title: Turn the brief into a story
stages.text: Developed the corporate spy-film script around the technical subject.

stages.title: Plan the production
stages.text: Planned shots and selected actors and production partners.

stages.title: Deliver the film
stages.text: Carried the story into a 14-minute film with English subtitles, supported by original scene and shot-planning material.

case_plans.result: The team project received the HR Brand Silver Screen special partner prize.
case_plans.scope_note: Corporate-film team project in the BASF / Frandesa context. HR Brand recognition was a Silver Screen special partner prize.

case_plans.title: Community & Advocacy — Health, Youth and Immigrant Stories
case_plans.card_summary: Communication and community work across LGBTQ+ health, youth initiatives and immigrant storytelling.
case_plans.task: Make sensitive information accessible and useful while creating room for people’s own voices.
case_plans.role: Print, web and social content; outreach; youth initiatives and partner communication; public immigrant storytelling.

stages.title: LGBTQ+ health and outreach
stages.text: At Vstrecha, a Global Fund partner, created and maintained web and print communication, annual reports and informational materials, alongside direct community outreach. The outreach role ran from June 2007 to December 2014.

stages.title: Youth initiatives
stages.text: Supported youth initiatives, media, mentoring and volunteer work in BELAU / UNICEF contexts.

stages.title: Immigrant storytelling
stages.text: Created public communication around immigration, asylum and adaptation; shared a personal LGBTQ+ asylee story with Human Rights First and other publishers. Human Rights First supported the public storytelling.

case_plans.result: A body of practical communication and advocacy spanning community health, youth support and public immigrant storytelling.
case_plans.scope_note: Vstrecha / Global Fund, BELAU / UNICEF and Human Rights First are separate activity contexts. Images include illustrative and symbolic portfolio adaptations.
